svg.text: Public Procurement Act: when will it be law?
Proposal since 9 Sep 2026; data of 28 October 2026. Steps of the ordinary legislative procedure.
Dot: median of the runs · thick bar: the middle half · thin bar: eight in ten. Pale bar: the initial assessment, for the proposal day.

European elections 2029: Parliament does no legislative work from its last session in April until the new committees vote again in October (assumption, as in 2024; the dates are not set yet).
